gloss: this world; the present life; this life

definitions.gloss: this world; the present life; this life
definitions.explanation: The current world or lifetime, as opposed to the afterlife or past/future lives. A concept rooted in Buddhist thought, contrasting with the previous life and the next life.

examples.english: To wish for happiness in this life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仏教|ぶっきょう}→仏教：11428_bukkyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{現世|げんせ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行|おこな}い→行い：14121_okonai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来世|らいせ}→来世：14988_raise⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{考|かんが}えられている→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: In Buddhism, one's actions in this life are believed to affect the next life.

examples.japanese: {現世|げんせ}{利益|りやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めて→求める：02316_motomeru⟧⟦お{寺|てら}→お寺：23515_otera⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参|まい}る→参る：01322_mairu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many people visit temples seeking worldly benefits.

notes:
A Buddhist-origin concept referring to the present existence. In Buddhist cosmology, existence is divided into three phases: ⟦{前世|ぜんせ}→前世：14987_zense⟧ (previous life), {現世|げんせ} (this life), and ⟦{来世|らいせ}→来世：14988_raise⟧ (next life).

ALTERNATIVE READING:
Also read as げんせい or うつし⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧. The reading うつし⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧ has a more literary, Shinto-influenced nuance meaning "the visible/real world" as opposed to the spirit world.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {現世|げんせ}{利益|りやく}: worldly benefits (blessings sought through prayer for this life)
- {現世|げんせ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行|おこな}い→行う：01238_okonau⟧: one's conduct in this life
- {現世|げんせ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧: to enjoy this life

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{前世|ぜんせ}→前世：14987_zense⟧: previous life — the life before this one
- ⟦{来世|らいせ}→来世：14988_raise⟧: next life, afterlife — the life after this one
- {三世|さんぜ}: three worlds/lives — past, present, and future existences
- {浮世|うきよ}: the floating world — the transient, pleasure-seeking world (Edo-era concept)
